company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed database schemas for storing, searching, and querying data from the Hazardous Substance Data Bank (HSDB). Backend database created with MySQL and integrated with Java/Hibernate.  Frontend database created with SQLite and C# for mobile devices.
•	Designed Android mobile application for the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services to assist first responders with hazardous chemical identification and decontamination procedures. Developed with Android Studio and Java.
•	Integrated the web application version with the backend database, utilizing HTML and JavaScript to search and display the data.

positions.title: Computer Science Department Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Instructed students in class, teaching them core constructs and Objected Oriented principles of Java and Processing.
•	Led review sessions for students prior to exams and quizzes. 
•	Assisted students in completing programming assignments in office hours and on Piazza.

positions.title: Computer Science Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Conducted memory acquisition and analysis with F-Response, FTK Imager, EnCase, and the Volatility Framework. 
- Performed analytics for intrusion detection utilizing Splunk, ELK, Snort, and Bro.
- Created challenge modules for NSA’s Cyber Defense Exercise (CDX) using Linux and Python.

honors.title: Northrop Grumman Mission Systems Scholarship
honors.description: Northrop Grumman's Engineering Scholars program provides scholarships to promising Maryland high school seniors who intend to pursue a career in engineering, computer science, mathematics or physics.

honors.title: Banneker/Key Scholar Class of 2020
honors.description: The Banneker/Key Scholarship is a four-year scholarship awarded on the basis of outstanding accomplishments and potential in scholarship, leadership, service and character.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Maryland · Mar 2016

volunteerExperiences.description: JoeyDCares Rock Orchestra is a community band that raises funds and creates awareness for local charities. I played an instrumental role in raising $20,000 for the Wounded Warrior Project, $8,000 for the Nathan Chris Baker Foundation, and $5,600 for the Special Olympics. I also helped younger members in my section to learn their music.
